title: Domestic ventilation.
officialText:
When a hood is required for proper ventilation of a domestic cooking appliance, the exhaust and
make-up air systems shall be properly engineered and designed in accordance with Chapter 5.
SECTION MC 918
FORCED-AIR WARM-AIR FURNACES
